verified_facts.text: The resort sits on a secluded barrier island.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on a secluded barrier Island, this Amelia Island beach resort marries coastal luxuries with authentic charm.

verified_facts.text: Every guestroom and suite has a private balcony and ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each of our luxury accommodations in Amelia Island features a private balcony and ocean views

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is a one-bedroom suite with a fireplace in the living area and a formal dining area seating six.
verified_facts.excerpt: the one-bedroom suite features a generous living area with a cozy fireplace and a formal dining area with seating for six.

verified_facts.text: Firetable Suites have a private fire pit outside, facing dunes and waves.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxuriate by your private fire pit and be moved by the magical combination of dunes, waves, and star-filled skies.

verified_facts.text: In the Hook, Line & Supper experience, guests fish with the Executive Chef on the Amelia River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests fish with Executive Chef along the scenic Amelia River on the west side of Amelia Island.

verified_facts.text: Coquina serves Latin cuisine focused on seafood and coastal dishes inspired by the island's Eight Flags heritage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Coquina is an innovative, new Amelia Island Latin restaurant with cuisine focused on seafood and coastal dishes inspired by the island’s Eight Flags heritage.

verified_facts.text: Three private boardwalks lead guests to the oceanfront, buffered by sand dunes and sea oats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three private boardwalks provide guest access to a quarter mile of pristine oceanfront, buffered by a natural landscape of sand dunes and sea oats.

verified_facts.text: The Golf Club of Amelia Island has an 18-hole course designed by Mark McCumber and Gene Littler.
verified_facts.excerpt: 18-hole championship golf course designed by PGA Tour veteran Mark McCumber and golf legend Gene Littler.

verified_facts.text: The Nature Center has three on-site Naturalists specializing in marine science and biology.
verified_facts.excerpt: With three on-site professional Naturalists specializing in Marine Science and Biology, the Nature Center offers enriching activities for everyone.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join the resort marine biologist to locate, track and record dolphin behavior for a research study on the Amelia River and Cumberland Sound.
verified_facts.excerpt: locate, track and record dolphin behavior for an on-going research study on the Amelia River and Cumberland Sound.

verified_facts.text: Beach horseback riding along the Atlantic shore is available, and Amelia Island is one of the few places where it is permitted.
verified_facts.excerpt: Amelia Island is one of the few places where beach horseback riding is permitted.

verified_facts.text: Tidewater Grill is a casual restaurant serving lunch, dinner and drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tidewater Grill has an instantly familiar, casual atmosphere for lunch, dinner, and drinks.

verified_facts.text: The resort partners with tennis coach Patrick Mouratoglou for training camps, private lessons and retreats.
verified_facts.excerpt: partner with the world-renowned tennis coach, Patrick Mouratoglou

verified_facts.text: Select public restrooms are being enhanced from October 2026 through January 2027.
verified_facts.excerpt: From October 2026 through January 2027, select public restrooms will undergo enhancements as part of the resort's continued investment in guest comfort and convenience.

verified_facts.text: The Legacy Function Space, including the Ritz-Carlton Ballroom and Plaza Ballroom, is being redesigned from November 16, 2026 to January 2027.
verified_facts.excerpt: From November 16, 2026 – January 2027, the resort's Legacy Function Space will enter its next chapter of transformation

verified_facts.text: While the main pool is enhanced, guests keep access to one of the resort's two pools throughout the project.
verified_facts.excerpt: As enhancements take place at the main pool, guests will continue to always enjoy access to one of the resort’s two pools throughout the project.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not have an airport shuttle to Fernandina Beach Municipal Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, The Ritz-Carlton, Amelia Island does not have an airport shuttle to Fernandina Beach Municipal Airport.

verified_facts.text: The resort is exclusively cashless; guests present a credit card at check-in.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, Amelia Island is an exclusively cashless resort. Guests must present a credit card at check-in
